Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 20066 Act Number: 6 Enactment Date: 2005-12-30 Act Year: 2006 Short Title: The Telangana Bio-fertilisers (Monitoring and Quality Control) Act, 2006. Long Title: An Act to provide for the maintenance of specified counts of viable cells of Microorganism, volume of Bio-fertilizer and to refrain from the production of contraband or spurious or phyto-toxi material and description of species of microorganism in the manufacture of a particular termed Bio-fertilizer and to monitor the effectiveness of the product in the label by the manufacturer and for the matters connected therewith or incidental thereto.
